package fixture

// Every shape that can put a request on the wire, so the guard's detector is
// pinned against something rather than against the repo happening to be
// clean. Not compiled (.go.txt) -- the repo walk must not see these.

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"time"
)

// A bare client: nothing observes what it sends.
var bare = &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}

// A reverse proxy sends through its own transport.
func proxy() *httputil.ReverseProxy {
	return &httputil.ReverseProxy{}
}

// The package-level senders use http.DefaultClient, which has no transport to
// wrap -- always a hole, never excusable.
func packageLevel() {
	_, _ = http.Get("https://api.github.com/user")
	_, _ = http.DefaultClient.Get("https://api.github.com/user")
}
